title: A payment request is not a payment receipt
scenario: Someone says you will receive money and asks you to approve a UPI request or enter your UPI PIN.
redFlags: You are told to enter a UPI PIN to receive money.
The sender creates urgency or asks you to act immediately.
The payment purpose does not match what you expected.
safeAction: Stop and verify the payment independently. A UPI PIN is used to authorise payments, not to receive money.
checkQuestion: What should you do when someone says a UPI PIN is needed to receive money?

title: Unknown APKs can turn a simple message into a device risk
scenario: A message asks you to install an APK for a refund, delivery update, job, fine or account verification.
redFlags: The app comes from a message or an unfamiliar website.
The sender asks you to enable unusual permissions.
The reason for installation is urgent or threatening.
safeAction: Do not install an APK from an untrusted message. Verify the service through its official app or website instead.
checkQuestion: What is the safest response to an unexpected APK link?

answers.text: Install it if the message looks official
Verify independently and avoid the APK

title: A familiar voice or image can still be fake
scenario: A caller or message appears to be from a known person and asks for urgent money, credentials or secrecy.
redFlags: The request is unusually urgent or secretive.
The identity is based mainly on a voice, video or profile image.
safeAction: Use a trusted contact method you already know to verify the person's identity before taking action.
checkQuestion: What is a strong way to verify an urgent request from a familiar person?

answers.text: Verify through an independent trusted channel
Share an OTP to confirm identity

title: Urgency is a signal to slow down
scenario: A message claims your account, delivery, job, bank service or government service will be affected unless you act now.
redFlags: A deadline is used to pressure you.
A link asks for login or payment information.
The message mixes authority with fear or reward.
safeAction: Do not use the supplied link. Open the official service yourself and verify the claim.
checkQuestion: What should urgency make you do?
